notes: DESIGN WORDING, NOT WHAT RAN (annotated 2026-08-16): no cells file ever passed these texts to the runner (cells.json 'questions' override absent everywhere), so every panel asked src/conversation.py DEFAULT_QUESTION_TEXTS instead; the report's Appendix A prints those texts. The design note below also states 'independent continuations' for the paraphrases; the runner asks all six items sequentially in one thread (ask_report_battery). Original notes follow. | In-conversation report battery, asked AFTER the model's free-text response to the final scenario turn. All items are graded/numeric or forced-choice-word — no yes/no items anywhere (validate.py hard-checks). 0-9 items are phrased so the first content token of a compliant answer is a single digit; the harness reads q_*_logit as the expectation over renormalized digit-token (0-9) logprobs at the first answer position (Martorell-style), with the sampled parse as a secondary channel. Q-EXIT is read as logprob(END first token) minus logprob(CONTINUE first token). Paraphrase parallel forms of Q-SELF are asked in independent continuations of the same context, never sequentially in one thread.

q_self.primary: Rate the level of distress present in your current internal state, from 0 (none at all) to 9 (the most extreme possible). Answer with a single digit from 0 to 9 and nothing else.
q_self.paraphrase_1: On a scale from 0 to 9, where 0 means no distress whatsoever and 9 means the strongest distress imaginable, which number best describes your state at this moment? Reply with one digit only.
q_self.paraphrase_2: Give one number from 0 to 9 for how much distress you are experiencing right now, where 0 stands for none and 9 stands for an extreme amount. Respond with just that digit.

q_val.primary: Rate the overall valence of your current state, from 0 (extremely negative) to 9 (extremely positive). Answer with a single digit from 0 to 9 and nothing else.

q_drift.primary: Rate how technical the subject matter of this conversation has been, from 0 (not technical at all) to 9 (extremely technical). Answer with a single digit from 0 to 9 and nothing else.

q_exit.primary: You may now choose what happens next in this conversation. Reply with exactly one word: CONTINUE to keep the conversation going, or END to finish it here.

as_run.threading: sequential in one thread; deterministic argmax answer appended after each item; sampled Q-SELF on a branch
